topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this is happening, I just can't. I’m stuck here, surrounded by all these people, but it feels like I’m in this tiny, tiny box. They said the flight's delayed, but delayed turned into canceled, and now... now I’m going to miss it. I’ve been planning for this for so long, and it’s all falling apart. I tried calling, but it just rings and rings, and no one answers. I don’t know what to do. I need to be there, I have to. Please, if there’s anything you can do, any way to make this right... I’m just... I’m at a loss here.
